title: Earth World Model: Physics-constrained latent dynamics for forecasting and environmental scenario analysis
abstract: arXiv:2611.18654v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: World models have been widely applied to multi-agent planning and forecasting, but exogenous environmental changes are rarely incorporated as replaceable drivers in a unified state-evolution process. This limits assessment of whether environmental perturbations propagate through physical systems with faithful dynamics. We propose the Earth World Model (EWM), an Earth-centred forecasting framework that compresses heterogeneous multi-source observations into a reusable low-dimensional latent state representing the system's history and current condition. Given explicit exogenous drivers, a shared transition operator recursively updates the latent state, and physics-constrained decoding produces multi-step forecasts. Replacing the drivers enables environmental scenario analysis and evaluation of dynamic-response fidelity. translated_title: 地球世界模型：面向预测与环境情景分析的物理约束潜空间动力学
translated_abstract: 世界模型已被广泛应用于多智能体规划与预测，但外生的环境变化很少作为可替换的驱动因素被纳入统一的状态演化过程中。这限制了对环境扰动能否以忠实的动力学在物理系统中传播进行评估的能力。我们提出了地球世界模型（EWM），这是一个以地球为中心的预测框架，它将异构的多源观测数据压缩为一个可复用的低维潜状态，用以表征系统的历史与当前状况。在给定显式外生驱动因素的条件下，一个共享的转移算子递归地更新潜状态，并通过物理约束的解码生成多步预测。通过替换驱动因素，即可实现环境情景分析并评估动态响应的保真度。我们在六个光伏站点和一个风电站点上评估了EWM在电力预测与环境扰动响应方面的表现。
tldr: 该论文提出地球世界模型（EWM），将多源异构观测压缩为可复用的低维潜状态，由共享转移算子递归演化并经物理约束解码生成多步预测，同时通过替换外生驱动因素实现环境情景分析与动态响应保真度评估。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Earth World Model (EWM), which compresses heterogeneous multi-source observations into a reusable low-dimensional latent state evolved recursively by a shared transition operator with physics-constrained decoding for multi-step forecasting, and enables environmental scenario analysis and dynamic-response fidelity evaluation by swapping exogenous drivers.
